confirmed_rules: ORB = the first 15 minutes of a session; Asia/London/NY; retest is the core entry (FP-001 v1 dialog + Part Three spoken).
Candle-CLOSE confirms a box break; a wick that sweeps = fakeout (Part One + general FP-001).
POC / VAH / VAL used as levels; target = the next POC; scale between POCs (Part Two + FP-001 POC labels).
EMAs 20/21/34/50/55 live inside [kyle] v1 (FP-001 dialog + Part Two spoken); Farouk does not use them.
'Signal Times' setting has little/no value (FP-001 'does nothing' + Part Three).
Inside a range/ORB = chop = no trade; trade the retest outside it (Part One box + Part Three ORB).
newly_clarified_rules: OWNERSHIP: [kyle] v2 draws the volume candles, the session RANGE boxes AND the VWAP — previously unknown (FP-001 only opened v1).
Volume 'yellow' candles = RELATIVE VOLUME (Volume Multiplier 2, Length 20) — mechanic now known.
Session RANGE boxes (full-session: London 08:00-13:00, NY 17:00-21:00, Tokyo 21:00-03:00, GMT) are DISTINCT from the 15-min ORB.
VWAP role = BIAS FILTER (above=bullish/below=bearish) + dynamic S/R; multi-timeframe (session/daily/weekly/monthly).
SFP mechanic = wick through a swing with NO candle close -> prints a DOT line -> sweep-retest entry.
POC/VAH/VAL are computed from a FIXED-RANGE volume profile per period (daily/3D/5D/weekly/2W/monthly).
ORB anatomy: green = top, blue midline = 'hidden liquidity', bottom = downside.
